entities.summary: HD 117618 b, named Noifasui by the IAU, is an exoplanet discovered orbiting the star HD 117618 in September 2004. The planet is a small gas giant with perhaps as little as a fifth the mass of Jupiter. It orbits close to its star in a very eccentric orbit.
